name: sasha-connector-runtime
description: Runtime dependencies of mcp/sasha-slides/server.ts inside the connector image. Versions pinned to the repo root's installed node_modules. No "type" field on purpose: tsx then emits CommonJS, which workflow-instructions.ts relies on for __dirname. The deck server's engine code (engine/src/model, engine/src/server) resolves yjs, y-protocols, lib0 and rxjs from here, so the image holds exactly one Yjs; ws serves the deck WebSocket.
